description: `loop.transcript` is the loop workspace's history window — a FIFO page across every step a loop ran, read from step_message directly rather than the shared, bounded event ring. No cursor means "the latest page", the same bottom-of-the-stream content a live loop already shows; `id` on each message is step_message's own global id, the cursor a next before/after call passes back. hasOlder says there is more to scroll to without the caller inferring it from the page size.

content.text: Patched the retry loop and reran the suite.
